safeAdd(uint a, uint b) returns a+b with overflow require.
safeSub(uint a, uint b) returns a-b with underflow require.
safeMul(uint a, uint b) returns a*b with multiplication overflow require.
safeDiv(uint a, uint b) returns a/b with divide-by-zero require.
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using raw subtraction.
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) reads balances mapping.
transfer(address to, uint tokens) debits msg.sender via safeSub and credits 'to' via safeAdd.
approve(address spender, uint tokens) writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) moves balances and deducts allowance.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) reads allowed mapping.
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) approves then calls receiveApproval on spender contract.
Payable fallback function that always reverts, refusing ETH.
onlyOwner function that calls transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary ERC20 token address.
Owned constructor setting owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function setting newOwner = _newOwner.
Sets owner = newOwner after requiring msg.sender == newOwner.
Constructor initializing symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and preminting balances to a fixed address.
External callback entry point receiveApproval(address from, uint256 tokens, address token, bytes data) invoked on spender contracts.
msg.sender - caller-controlled address used for balances, allowances and ownership checks.
Unchecked addition c = a + b inside safeAdd guarded only by require(c >= a).
Subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub guarded by require(b <= a).
Multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Division c = a / b inside safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) to an attacker-supplied contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary token contract.
Access control guard require(msg.sender == owner) in the onlyOwner modifier.
Raw unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply().

edges.reason: msg.sender selects the balance debited in transfer, so caller identity governs which funds move.
msg.sender is the approving owner whose allowance is written in approve.
msg.sender's allowance is consumed in transferFrom, giving the caller spend authority.
msg.sender is used both as approver and as the from argument of the external receiveApproval callback.
Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing privileged control.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
msg.sender is compared against owner in the onlyOwner guard.
onlyOwner guard gates transferAnyERC20Token, which moves tokens held by the contract.
onlyOwner guard gates transferOwnership, which sets the pending newOwner.
The onlyOwner guard reads the owner state variable.
